svg.metadata: Target coastline: GSHHS/GSHHG via Basemap resolution=i (GSHHG LGPL); Papua New Guinea–Indonesia land border: Basemap countries_i boundary data, consistent with Natural Earth regional classification; offshore PNG island membership cross-checked with Natural Earth admin-0. Surrounding land: GSHHS/GSHHG resolution=i, drawn to the canvas edge. Shared local-equirectangular-fit-v1, regenerated 2026-10-06 to remove canvas-edge clipping.
